title: PyMuPDF compatibility surface, one class per file
description: Contract for specs/api/<class>.yaml. Seeded from the pinned black box (interface shapes only); tiers arrive from specs/api/usage.json via scripts/compat/apply_usage.py. Checked by scripts/compat/validate_spec.py.

class.description: Black-box class name, or 'module' for module-level functions.

rust_path.description: Planned path under the pdfluent::compat module (may not exist yet).

signature.description: Parameter list from inspect.signature only, receiver stripped; '()' for properties, '(...)' when not introspectable.

names.description: Member name per binding (planned; unique within the class).

rust.description: Planned Rust path relative to pdfluent::compat (Class::member, Class::new, or a bare function name).

tier.description: Usage tier (T1 = top 80% of calls, T2 = next 15%); unranked until the usage job fills it.

lane.description: P0 value types; L1 text; L2 document ops; L3 pixmap/images; L4 editing; L5 module-level entry points.

status.description: Whether our tree already carries an equivalent with compatible semantics.

items.description: Differential case id, tests/compat/cases/<lane>/<case_id>.py; dotted or kebab, first segment a lane.

contract.description: Guaranteed behaviour where the member deliberately differs from the reference; only with status differs.
